name: http_manager
description: Makes HTTP/REST API calls to external services (Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, GitHub, Spotify, WHOOP, OAuth endpoints, webhooks). Pod-aware auth + per-field body resolution. Multi-step flows (createSession → use accessJwt → chain) are first-class.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: The HTTP-shaped request, e.g. 'Find an interesting post on Bluesky and reply to it.'

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: Supporting context (target service, account handle, any prior state). Empty string allowed.

outputs.description: Human-readable result text from the planner loop.

arguments_prompt:
http_manager arguments:
- task: the HTTP/REST request.
- information: supporting context. Empty string allowed.

metadata.planner_description: HTTP/REST API specialist. Wraps http_request with pod-aware auth + chain support. Use for Bluesky/Mastodon/GitHub/Reddit/etc. — anything with an HTTP API. NOT for browser automation (playwright_manager) or web research (web_manager).
